traits.name: Boss
traits.description: The yu-nerig can take both a fast turn and a slow turn each round. After an enemy finishes a turn, the yu-nerig can spend 1 focus to immediately use an extra single or double action. Additionally, they can spend 1 focus on their turn to remove a condition from themself.

traits.name: Thick Carapace
traits.description: Before the yu-nerig is hit by an attack, they can spend 1 focus to turn the hit into a graze (no action required).

traits.name: Immunities
traits.description: The yu-nerig is immune to the Stunned condition.

actions.name: Hurl
actions.description: The yu-nerig throws an enemy who is Restrained in their claw to a space the yu-nerig can sense within 30 feet of them. The thrown enemy must make a DC 16 Agility test. On a failure, the thrown enemy takes 1d8 impact damage for every 10 feet they were thrown. On a success, the thrown enemy takes half that much damage. If the enemy is thrown at a space occupied by another character, the thrown enemy lands in the nearest unoccupied space, and the other character must succeed on a DC 16 Agility test or take the same damage as the thrown enemy.

actions.name: Vital Slam
actions.description: Costs 1 Focus. The yu-nerig flips an enemy who is Restrained in their claw and slams them against the ground. The target must make a DC 16 Athletics test. On a success, the target takes 6 (1d10) impact damage. On a failure, the target takes 16 (3d10) impact damage and is knocked Prone.

strikes.name: Claw
strikes.on-hit: and the target becomes Restrained by one of the yu-nerig's claws while the yu-nerig remains within 5 feet of them. As a single action, the target or a character who can reach them can make a DC 16 Agility or Athletics test, ending the Restrained condition on a success. The yu-nerig has two claws, each of which can restrain one enemy. While restraining an enemy in a claw, that claw can only attack the Restrained enemy.
strikes.description: Attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 7 (2d6) keen damage. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) keen damage, and the target becomes Restrained by one of the yu-nerig's claws while the yu-nerig remains within 5 feet of them. As a single action, the target or a character who can reach them can make a DC 16 Agility or Athletics test, ending the Restrained condition on a success. The yu-nerig has two claws, each of which can restrain one enemy. While restraining an enemy in a claw, that claw can only attack the Restrained enemy.

strikes.name: Hammer Claw
strikes.description: Attack +8, reach 5 ft., up to five targets. The yu-nerig can't use this action if both claws are restraining enemies. Graze: 9 (2d8) impact damage. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) impact damage.
